summary: Read materialized Compendium I12–15 and newly pinned De ente et essentia capp.3–4 (Baur/Koch Corpus Thomisticum numbering,69874–5). De ente enumerates three multiplication modes, distinguishes addition-excluding pure esse from indeterminate common being, and takes genus/differentia of simple immaterial quiddities from the whole rather than real quiddity-parts. This narrows the live bridge but supplies no independently defended exhaustive exclusion of primitive whole-subject individuation or different whole essences. Rejected unrestricted identity-predicate PII, inferring real composition from predication, common numerical nature from one predicate, and reverse use of the all-other-things-receive-esse conclusion whose source derivation already uses uniqueness. Precise locators, strongest rival and conditional defense boundaries persist in docs/notes/necessary-simple-plurality.md. No new claim/theorem, no added/removed/discharged premise; intended and actual root delta zero. Follow-up: read materialized ST I q.7 aa.1–2 in full. A.1 distinguishes matter perfected by form from form contracted by matter; ad3 distinguishes unreceived from received instances, not two unreceived beings. A.2 co. infers reception/contraction from stated created-form essence/esse nonidentity, not nonidentity from determinate nature. Sed contra uses all-others causal dependence; ad1 uses createdness. Neither supplies an independent exclusion of two uncreated whole essences each identical with esse. The existing note preserves exact within-article locators and rejected converse. #697 constitutive-content test: materialized/read full Compendium I12–15, ST Iq3a3, q11a3 and q4a2. General singular-basis incommunicability is distinct from proper-God suppositum/nature scope; the latter requires an explicit first-mover adapter. Q4a2 obj2/reply1–2 permits opposed forms to preexist eminently as one, so formal essence difference cannot silently supply an absent eminent perfection. New zero-axiom conditional compositions separate complete nature content from SAME-InAct alignment, derive the exact old differentiation premise with explicit EM, and derive at-most-one through imported Q11. The unchanged original PartFreePlurality.JointControl supports independent omissions: old act-content alignment lacks completeness; an injective same-carrier code lacks alignment. Auxiliary positive consistency witness reuses the existing OneFirstMover.Joint carrier/motion/act with explicitly different represented principles/content, not the plural ontology. Rejected arbitrary respect-dictionary padding and unrestricted identity-predicate PII. All three new semantic/domain interfaces remain OPEN and independent warrant is blocked; no source claim or old Challenge changes. Default designated-root report remains63 and every route cost unchanged; differentiation is now displayed as proved resting on open premises, not closed. The existing note records precise projection scope, all assignments, strongest reply and source locators. The changed assignments do not preserve the full original ontology. Combined scratch diagnostics were empty (content SHA 6bbcd7ed9a363d4d15a983b34554e76672498d168d6a856884dc968fa7854a45); the associated configuration records six deletion models and the conditional incompatibility. Final delivered-head verification and review remain required; no root discharge is claimed.
blocker: Defend independently why every real difference between the same proposed unreceived simple candidates must be an additional limiting/receiving principle, or derive a narrower premise acceptable to the primitive-identity/different-whole-essence rival; also defend addition-excluding esse tantum applicability. The source assertion of exhaustiveness is not an independent proof. Q.7 a.2 only supplies nonidentity-to-reception; defending its converse for the same disputed whole essences remains open. Createdness/all-others causal scope cannot be silently assumed against an independent uncreated plural rival. Specifically defend that actual candidate natures have complete constitutive content in the SAME act/perfection sense, and that the actual selected underived individual falls under the first-mover suppositum/nature adapter. A formal difference alone does not imply absence of an eminent perfection. The new conditional derivations do not discharge those interfaces.
